statements.text: Like any tool, AI in and of itself isn’t good or bad; what matters is, ultimately, how we use it.
I believe the main issue with this new technology is that AI tools can become a crutch for students and diminish their ability to develop critical thinking skills.

AI learning tools cannot be a substitute for our children’s education – it should be used to aid their education.

we need to involve the 21st century of AI into the things that we do between doctors, and hospitals, and drug companies, and all the things that can cut back costs. They're there, we just don't use them for some reason.

statements.text:

statements.text: We've got to teach AI," Tuberville said. "We've got to teach kids in the classroom because they're going to learn it regardless.

statements.text: We're going to be very progressive with AI. AI is coming. There's no way you can stop it. And so we want to welcome it, but we want to use it the right way. statements.text: Remember when people said the internet was just a fad? Well, AI ain’t coming, folks. AI is here. America—not Communist China—needs to lead it, and I want Alabama at the front.

Here’s my message to data centers: If you want to use our resources, you pay full taxes, cover the total cost of your energy, and replace what you take. We’ll welcome you with open arms, but keep your hands out of our pockets.
